name: Original Spline keyboard asset
detail: The actual public Spline scene is loaded, rather than a CSS keyboard imitation.

name: Elastic keyboard reveal and falling keycaps
detail: Staggered bounce animation assembles the keycaps on load.

name: Hover and physical-key technology selection
detail: Spline hover/down events select tool names, with form-input guards.

name: Press and release sounds
detail: Original audio files play only when the visitor turns sound on.

name: Scroll-based keyboard choreography
detail: A dedicated sticky scroll tour has hero, skills, projects and contact stages.

name: Bongo Cat
detail: Original two-frame cat animation appears in the projects stage.

name: Floating contact keycaps
detail: Contact stage lifts the keycaps. A manual explode/reassemble control works on the home scene too.

name: Offscreen and hidden-tab pause
detail: Intersection and document-visibility observers pause the Spline scene.

name: Smooth scrolling and magnetic navigation
detail: Lenis smooth scrolling and pointer-relative button movement.

name: Project details and responsive views
detail: Expandable index, flip cards, responsive full-page project views and real app previews.

name: Magnifying technology dock
detail: Skill tiles magnify with neighboring tiles on hover and link to documented project filters.

name: Experience and publication content
detail: Your supplied experience replaces the reference owner's biography. Research manuscripts are not invented.

name: Résumé drawing overlay
detail: Five pen colors, draw toggle, clear action, doodle-layer export and clean PDF download.

name: Light/dark themes and reduced motion
detail: Remembered device-local preferences with pointer and motion fallbacks.

name: Nyan Cat N shortcut
detail: Original cat asset animates across the page; shortcut ignores editable fields.

name: Six-emoji right-click reactions
detail: Radial reaction menu on ordinary content; holding a reaction increases the confetti burst.

name: Contact delivery
detail: Direct mailto links use your supplied email. No email service has been provisioned, and no message is falsely marked sent.

name: Developer-tools surprise
detail: Console greeting and explorable command terminal. No invasive devtools-open detector.

name: Optional Socket.IO chat and presence
detail: The original optional backend was not in its public frontend repository and was not active in the audit. This build does not pretend to have live chat visitors.

name: Original analytics and domain beacon
detail: The reference owner's tracking IDs and domain beacon are not copied into your portfolio.

name: Colonia Zacamil world
detail: Newly authored neighborhood geometry, orbit/zoom controls, moving cars, trees and explorable pins. The original application bundle and mural artwork are not republished.
